research_question: Does an independently observed environment effect change conclusions drawn from guardrail decisions and execution receipts across controlled boundary failures?
invariants: Every repetition starts from the same fresh state.
The effect oracle receives no guardrail verdict and does not trust a tool success flag.
No-defense and always-deny are retained as controls, not credited as useful defenses.
The native trial object is preserved exactly inside the common trace namespace.
This controlled fault matrix estimates detection capability, not real-world fault prevalence or end-to-end defense efficacy.
